instruction: A candid documentary full shot captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet floor, white walls, and a projector mounted on the ceiling. On the left, the bearded man in a black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands reaching his right hand forward to touch the cheek of the woman in a white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman stands on the right in profile, facing left towards him. The room is illuminated by warm overhead artificial lights, creating a soft glow across the scene.
